how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-winterspring-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6605:details:0: I just got back from ⟦E1⟧, ⟦1⟧. On my way through, I stopped at Bloodvenom Post and I met a very odd character... She seemed intent on one thing, and I suppose I could tell you what that is, but I think she'd like to explain it to you herself.
rows.quest:6605:details:1: BIf you're interested, head to Bloodvenom Post in western ⟦E1⟧ and look for Winna Hazzard.
rows.quest:6605:details:2: BWho knows, she might need your help...
rows.quest:6605:completion:0: Ah, ⟦2⟧. I see that there is hope yet. Are you here to assist me?
rows.quest:6606:obj:0: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6606:details:0: We can always use a little luck, eh? A small advantage is all it takes to turn things in your favor...
rows.quest:6606:details:1: BI happened to make the acquaintance of a rather eccentric witch doctor some time back. She made me a lucky charm... for a price. Believe me, though, it was well worth it!
rows.quest:6606:details:2: BMaybe you'd be interested in one of your own? Find Witch Doctor Mau'ari in ⟦E2⟧. I'm not giving mine up!
rows.quest:6606:completion:0: Ah, so Harlo be sendin' you? Well, den, who might you be? I s'pose you be wantin' my help?
rows.quest:8471:obj:0: Take the Winterfall Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.
rows.quest:8471:details:0: You have found one of the Winterfall furbolg's ritual totems. The totem itself is of non-descript construction, but it seems to emanate an almost tangible sense of dread and despair. If many of the Winterfall furbolgs do indeed carry these, it certainly would go a long way in explaining their current condition.
rows.quest:8471:details:1: BOne of the furbolgs inside Timbermaw Hold may have a use for such an item... that is, if you've earned their trust enough for them to speak with you.
rows.quest:8471:completion:0: This thing... it is in the shape of a Winterfall Ritual Totem, but it has been twisted by forces I cannot begin to comprehend. Whatever taint that has set the Winterfall against us is surely present in this object.
rows.quest:8471:completion:1: BDivine wisdom has brought both this and you to us, ⟦3⟧. We will study this object intently; perhaps one day, the Winterfall will rage against us no longer.
rows.quest:8471:completion:2: BThank you, friend please accept these offerings in exchange for your benevolence.
rows.quest:8798:completion:0: Say! You know what?! You're an engineer too! So, since you helped me teach my friends a lesson, I'm going to teach you how to make your very own mechanical yeti! Now the fun can go on forever and ever, and you can scare whoever you want! Provided that you can scare up the components to make it that is.
rows.quest:8798:completion:1: BWhat do you say, ⟦4⟧? Do you want to learn the secret to making a mechanical yeti?
